name: modverse
description: MODVerse - Enterprise MOD APK platform with an autonomous AI ingestion agent.

scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @modverse/web
scripts.build:agent: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @modverse/agent
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @modverse/web && npm run build -w @modverse/agent
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,agent -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:agent"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @modverse/web && npm run typecheck -w @modverse/agent
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/web/.next apps/agent/dist packages/shared/dist
